sections.heading: Planning your Jurong Arcadia interior
sections.text:
Jurong West is a large, well-equipped western town, and owners who are close to keys usually plan the first fit-out as a long stay: a kitchen that can take family cooking, bedrooms with proper wardrobes, and a living room with built-in storage rather than loose cabinets. Maison will design that work as built-in carpentry — fitted kitchen cabinets, full-height wardrobes, an entry cabinet, and a living-room joinery wall — not as flat-pack furniture. We have no official floor plan on file and will not invent typologies or a typical Jurong Arcadia layout.

Jurong West Crystal is the other Jurong West HDB page in this batch and carries the same warning about unconfirmed months; it is not a typologies reference for Arcadia. Lakeside View, already live, and Lucerne Grand, packed earlier, are nearby links in the wider Jurong region. We will not invent walking times to a lake, to Jurong East, or to any MRT station. Check your block, facing and the HDB renovation rules before you plan blinds or any hacking.

After keys, inspect defects, then obtain the HDB renovation permit before fabrication. A moderate, non-structural carpentry scope is often planned at six to ten weeks on site after access and approvals, as an editorial planning figure only. WhatsApp Maison with your approved plan and any key letter you have. We are not affiliated with HDB.
